_comment: cúramóir hooks. Verified against the live hooks and manifest references
2026-10-06. Re-verify before editing: hook event names and the PreToolUse
The denylist hook (E0-R5) is scoped to Bash by `matcher`, so it is not
invoked for other tools, and carries a short explicit `timeout`. The default
is 600s and a timed-out command hook fails OPEN, so an unbounded timeout
would stall every Bash call for ten minutes while protecting nothing.
The command goes through scripts/curamoir-hook-pretooluse rather than
`python3 -m curamoir.hooks.pretooluse`, because an installed plugin is an
unpacked directory and `curamoir` is not on the import path. The wrapper
sets it from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. The variable is quoted so a plugin path
Guards promoted from rules (E4-R4b) register separately with matcher
'Edit|Write'. SessionStart / Stop / PreCompact handoff hooks are Epic 8's.
